The three-gate BTC re-entry framework is fully satisfied (Gate 1: July 3 UTC close $62,579; Gate 2: July 4 UTC close $63,015; Gate 3: IBIT $209M July 6), activating BTC re-entry at 9:30 AM ET. NVDA pre-market is $197.16 — the full-size add gate ($200 simultaneously at 9:25 AM ET) is NOT triggered; hold half-size only through August 26 Q2 FY27 earnings. BUY regime remains technically intact (SPX futures above 7,460, VIX 14.9), but the Kyber-driven semi headwind limits the call to HOLD. FOMC minutes Wednesday July 8 is the next regime risk (9/18 members supported rate hike at June meeting).

bear_case: FOMC minutes Wednesday July 8 represent the highest-probability regime disruption in the next 72 hours. The June 17 committee meeting was split (9/18 members supported rate hike appropriate for 2026), and the minutes were written before the 57K NFP soft jobs print — they will read more hawkish than current market pricing, which has already priced the July hike probability down to 20%. A hawkish minutes read, even without a policy change, could push VIX through 17 and break the dual-gate BUY regime after only one session of activation. The Kyber NVL144 delay is not merely a manufacturing setback — SemiAnalysis has a near-perfect supply chain track record, and a 78-layer PCB midplane failure is the type of fundamental constraint that does not resolve in two quarters. If hyperscaler customers (Microsoft, Google, AWS) begin pushing out rack orders as a result of Vera Rubin Ultra slipping, NVDA's August 26 earnings guide revision risk rises materially. SKHY's $29B Nasdaq ADR IPO on July 10 is the largest foreign IPO ever — it absorbs institutional capital from the AI/memory complex (NVDA, MU, TSM) into a competing semi-adjacent vehicle. If SPX fails to hold 7,460 on July 7 close (Dual-gate Day 2 failure), the entire BUY regime reverts to HOLD.
